decisions.reason: The protection cap remains a peripheral accessory with limited public commitment, and after several years of weak sales the disappointing results can no longer be attributed to temporary causes, so the firm drops it to free resources.
As a core, publicly prominent box car trailer series central to the firm's strategy, the large sunk investments and strong public commitment make dropping very unlikely.
The low-bed trailer series is highly visible and central to the firm's quality and reliability positioning, so escalation pressures strongly favor keeping it.
The high trailer cover series remains publicly featured as a complement to the trailer portfolio, and the firm continues to support it to recoup its investment.
Despite possible overlap with Product B, the firm has committed publicly and invested heavily in this box car series, so escalation of commitment leads to keeping it, though with some uncertainty.
